snippet.title: Vinyl Goddess from Mars - Episode I: Forests of Old (Longplay) (PC-MS DOS, 1995)
snippet.description:
Full gameplay of first episode of Vinyl Goddess from Mars, a platform game for MS-DOS developed by Six Pound Sledge Studios and published by Union Logic Software Publishing in 1995.

Emulator: DOSBox-X 2022.08.0
Operating system: GNU/Linux Ubuntu 18.04
